purpose: Decorative concept imagery for shared desktop route heroes; not photographs of the dealer premises.
processing: Original 2172x724 PNG outputs encoded as WebP at quality 88 without resizing or compositing.

prompts.home: Create one finished website hero BACKGROUND PHOTO, ultrawide landscape 3:1 composition, luxury automotive editorial photography, restrained European design. A pale warm silver minimalist automotive studio, softly illuminated ivory back wall, polished pale stone floor, long recessed ceiling light channels, exquisite believable materials. A graphite premium coupe tightly cropped entering from the far LEFT edge and a pearl white performance SUV tightly cropped entering from the far RIGHT edge, each confined to the outermost 18 percent of the canvas, natural integrated floor shadows. Critical layout: central 64 percent of image is calm EMPTY pale ivory/grey architectural negative space, no cars or objects or high contrast edges in that center. Center will hold a website headline and large search form, do not render any UI. Vehicles sit on a shared low floor baseline about 78 percent down image. Top 25 percent quiet as website navigation overlays it. Cars recognizable as premium European styling but NO readable brand badges, no text, no logos, no lettering, no people. High end realistic photography not abstract sci-fi, not a collage. Delicate warm daylight, precise architecture, neutral palette with tiny restrained red details only on distant side wall. No black vignette, no text, no watermark. The image is a decorative conceptual showroom, not a photograph of an actual dealership.
